paragraphs: Neighborly Software sells a cloud platform for administering and disbursing government funds. It connects administrators, participants, contractors and homeowners in one system for local, state and nonprofit organizations.

The programs covered include housing, economic and community development, disaster recovery and mitigation, home energy rebates, and housing choice vouchers. Community development activity runs from application to closeout on a single platform. Integration with the IDIS reporting system is meant to end duplicate data entry. For disaster recovery grants, the company says it implements in weeks rather than months.

The company says more than a third of HUD entitlement jurisdictions choose it. Published case studies include Prince William County, Virginia. It dates to 2016 and says it has delivered software to more than 700 public and private sector entities across the country. Co-founder and president Jason Rusnak previously held management positions at Accenture and ADP.

quote.text: Helping Communities Help People is at the heart of all we do.
